svg.title: AI request lifecycle - AnswerState (one AnswerStateMachine per RequestTicket)

g.text: AI request lifecycle - AnswerState (one AnswerStateMachine per RequestTicket)
from terminal: rejected (late states are ignored)
Failed / Cancelled: from any non-terminal state
cancel_all(false): start_meeting, pause, stop_meeting (Background kept alive)
AnswerStateChanged { request_id, state, error } is emitted only for the
Primary and Followups slots: while the ticket is current, and always
for terminal states so the UI never hangs on a spinner.
answer_transition_allowed rejects that move, so a
successful run leaves the machine in Created
reports a cancelled call as Failed.
